section_summary.extract_value: This Discussion section presents findings from a single study examining predictors of cosmetic surgery consideration among female undergraduates. Body appreciation, media influence (SATAQ-3 subscales), and weight status were significant predictors, with body appreciation being the strongest predictor. The authors note limitations including the restricted sample (undergraduate women with limited BMI and age range) and suggest future research should include additional psychological variables and use more representative community samples.
